structural_breaks.note: Demerger of ABB India Ltd Power Grids business into ABB Power Products and Systems India Ltd (NCLT order 2019-11-27, filed with RoC 2019-12-01, appointed date 2019-04-01; company incorporated 2019-02-19). No company-level quarterly data before Apr-Jun 2019; Apr-Dec 2019 quarters exist only as comparatives.

Fiscal-year change: CY2020 (Jan-Dec) -> 15-month period 2021-01-01..2022-03-31 (Q1..Q5) -> Indian FY Apr-Mar from FY2022-23. Quarters are all calendar quarters, so keys are remapped to Apr-Mar FY by actual dates.

Comparatives for CY2020 quarters restated slightly in later filings (e.g. Jul-Sep 2020 931.94 -> 933.24 crore; Apr-Jun 2020 633.24 -> 632.97; Jan-Mar 2020 811.55 -> 810.62). Values keep first publication; prior_year_comparative uses each statement's own restated comparative.

ABB India regrouped businesses from Power Grids into a new 'Others' segment in Q1 CY2018: CY2017 Power Grids restated 3,832.43 -> 3,128.87 crore (e.g. Jan-Mar 2017 864.81 -> 685.14; Oct-Dec 2017 1,223.87 -> 1,089.93). Predecessor points keep first-published values; prior_year_comparative is from the same statement (restated basis).
GST: ABB India revenue up to 2017-06-30 inclusive of excise duty; flagged per point (predecessor YoY for FY2018Q2-FY2019Q1 not like-for-like).

ABB India classified Power Grids as discontinued operations from Q4 CY2018 (after ABB Ltd agreed to sell Power Grids to Hitachi, 2018-12-17); predecessor values from then are the "Power Grids (Discontinued operations)" segment revenue line.
QIP equity raise (Mar 2025) — no scope change. Orders include lumpy HVDC awards in FY2023Q1, FY2025Q3, FY2026Q1, FY2027Q1 (company reports growth ex-HVDC).

profile.products: Power, distribution, small, dry-type, traction and instrument transformers, bushings; transformer insulation pressboard/paper; breakers, GIS (220-765 kV), AIS substations, HVDC (incl. 1,000 MW VSC Mumbai infeed), STATCOM/FACTS, capacitors & filters, protection & control, grid automation, service. FY2025-26 orders included multiple 500 MVA 765 kV bulk transformers & reactors and 3,150 kVA dry-type transformers (AR 2025-26 p.54, p.76, p.119). Exports 26.19% of FY2025-26 turnover to 70+ countries; export orders from the US, Europe and APAC (AR p.17, p.76).

plants.products: power transformer factory (NABL-accredited lab), energy technology experience center
manufacturing facility (transformer/components; product split per site not stated in AR map)
greenfield large power transformer facility (commissioning FY2025-26/FY2026-27; construction of 20th unit started Jun 2026)
electrical insulation pressboard for transformers (ultra-low-carbon pressboard facility)

profile.end_markets: Indian utilities (transmission incl. 765 kV, HVDC), renewables integration (solar/wind), railways/metro (traction transformers), data centers, industry; exports (~26% of turnover) to US, Europe, APAC, Africa.

proxy_routes.why: 국내 전기장비(NIC 27) 생산 사이클 — 매출의 ~74%가 인도 내수(유틸리티·산업·철도)
인도 대형 전력변압기(>10MVA) 수출 — Maneja/Karjan 대형 변압기 수출(US·EU·APAC) 포함
미국의 인도산 >10MVA 변압기 수입 — AR상 미국향 수출 수주
인도→미국 대형 변압기 수출(수출국 측 통계)
인도 건식 변압기(>500kVA) 수출 — Halol 건식·견인 변압기 공장
미국의 인도산 고압 차단기(≥72.5kV) 수입 — HV 제품(차단기/GIS) 수출
미국 전기장비 신규수주 — 인도산 변압기 수입 수요 견인(수출 26%)
CEA 월간 송전 진척보고서의 220kV 이상 변전 용량 증설(MVA) — 국내 인도 물량 직접 지표(CEA Monthly Transmission Report)
인도 ISTS(TBCB/RTM) 송전 프로젝트 낙찰액(Ministry of Power/NCT) — 수주 선행
